name: Mexican-Style Lager
line: A crisp, clean lager designed to be the cold partner for chile heat.

name: Pilsner
line: A dry, crisp pilsner designed to cut through fried and spicy food.

name: Hefeweizen
line: Designed to show banana and clove in balance. The beer every other NASHA beer has to earn its place beside.

name: Witbier
line: A soft, citrusy wheat beer designed for warm weather and seafood.

name: Dunkelweizen
line: Banana and clove over toast and a hint of chocolate, designed for cooler months.

name: Vienna Amber
line: Toasted bread-crust malt, designed to meet char and braise.

name: Deccan Sol
line: A pilot idea: wheat lager with coriander seed and perhaps toasted sesame, each only if it improves aroma without hurting the beer.

name: Goa Baja
line: A pilot idea: a lager with a touch of sour fruit and sea salt. It launches only if a pilot proves it.

name: Malabar Dark
line: A winter pilot idea: dark wheat beer with black pepper and cacao. It needs foam, stability and regulatory checks first.
